about_the_game:
Overview:

The Rake is a Singleplayer open-world survival horror game where you have to hunt down and kill the urban legend "The Rake". You can use guns, melee weapons, beartraps, a handheld motion sensor, gun attachments, trailcams, medical equipment, food, and anything else you can find to survive, defend yourself, and win against The Rake while exploring or doing quests in the detailed and realistic open world.

if you'd like to give me suggestions, feedback, ask me question, or just want keep up with new updates, announcements, trailers, and new screenshots join the Discord. 

Features:

  • Continuous Updates, New Content, & Rake Improvements

  • Detailed Open-World with Locations filled with Lore & Loot

  • 1+ Hour Long Main Quest/Campaign

  • Dynamic Day/Night Cycle with Dynamic Weather, Fog, FX, and Sounds

  • Original Soundtrack

  • Wide Variety of Melee Weapons & Guns like ARs, Pistols, SMGs, & More

  • Equipment like Night Vision, Handheld Motion Sensor, Weapon Attachments, & More

  • Deployable Beartraps & Cameras

  • PC Desktop System with Flyable Drone

  • Inventory System with Storage

Lore: 

The main campaign takes place in Hells Valley National Park in Pennsylvania, which has been closed off to the public for years due to dozens of murders and unexplained disappearances. You have been invited by your friend to help him hunt The Rake after years of tracking down its home. You arrive only to find a blood stain, flashlight, and frantically written note. This is where the main quest picks up, which revolves around going from location to location searching for your friend while completing mini-objectives and having to defend yourself from The Rake along the way. The main quest is non-linear so you can complete any quest at anytime, but the main quest is completely optional so if you want to just explore the map and kill the rake you can do that too.

Analog Horror:

The game also has an analog horror series that takes place fully in-universe. The first season is currently on-going & will give backstory/lore for the first campaign: Hells Valley National Park & future seasons will focus on future maps and campaigns slowly building and expanding the world and universe adding more lore. You can watch the full series as its coming out on the Kanoleiro YouTube channel with the link on the Steam sidebar.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600X, Intel Core i5-7600K
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 Ti, AMD Radeon RX 6500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, Intel Core i7-8700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER, AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

short_description: The Rake is an open-world singleplayer horror game where you can explore, complete the main quest, or hunt The Rake using Pistols, Beartraps, SMGs, ARs, Melee Weapons, Handheld Motion Sensors, Weapon Attachments, Health Items, Trail Cams, and whatever else you can find to survive.
